summary: Scoped secure tunneled log-view provisioning for customer incident replay
description:
Issue summary: Customer reported a production divergence where short responses were missing user-provided context. Support needs a timeboxed, audited view into the raw request/response log index to replay the session and validate whether KV-cache prefixing or routing fallback caused the omission.

Impact: One enterprise customer (self-hosted integration via Dedicated) has a live support case opened; inability to reproduce blocks a mitigation path. Low blast radius requested: one account, single 30-minute window of logs.

Background: Customer incident INC-2026-309 flagged a mismatch between what was sent by the client and tokens returned. Initial tracing points to a routing fallback at 2026-03-11T14:22:00Z that may have caused a model variant switch. Support cannot fully reconstruct the session with current aggregated observability because payloads were sampled. This request seeks ephemeral privileged view for forensic replay under strict controls.
steps_to_reproduce: 1) Identify customer session by session_id provided in support case.
2) Open tunneled, read-only view into production log index limited to session_id and +/- 15 minutes.
3) Replay request/response pairs in a sandboxed replay tool; do not re-infer on production runtime.
4) Capture findings and relevant redacted snippets into support case notes.
logs: Time window: 2026-03-11T14:07:00Z to 2026-03-11T14:37:00Z; indices: prod-inference-requests-*, prod-streaming-kvcache-*. Query will include hashed_user_id and session_id filters only.
investigation_notes: Hypotheses: 1) Routing fallback triggered model variant that lacked KV-cache prefixing. 2) Streaming connector truncated first token due to intermittent socket reset. Partial findings: trace sampling suggests a connector error 14:22:03Z; no full payloads in aggregated logs. Need raw entries to confirm headers and encoded prefix keys.
access_requested: Temporary IAM role: support/replay-temp (assume-role with mfa, session duration 2h). Access pathway: SSH tunnel to log-gateway via bastion with recorded session and read-only Kibana-like viewer. No raw payload export allowed; any snippet export requires additional approval from Security + Legal.
data_minimization: Search will be constrained to the single session_id and hashed identifiers. Redaction policy: full PII redaction on export; view-only session will mask any detected email/SSN strings unless required for customer debugging and then handled under legal dual-approval.
audit_controls: All actions recorded in CloudTrail and session-recording S3 bucket with KMS encryption. Access grant will be time-limited and requires two approvers. Post-access: generation of an access report summarizing queries run and snippets viewed; to be attached to support case and retained per retention policy.
